name: Roofing, commercial
description: TPO (mechanically attached), EPDM (fully adhered) and two-ply modified bitumen systems over polyiso, tapered areas, roof edges and copings, drains, pipe and curb flashings, walkway pads. Attachment counts are starting figures for the wind design to replace. Assemblies only: set your own rates.
author: CadCraft

sources.title: International Building Code, Chapter 15 Roof Assemblies and Rooftop Structures, Section 1507 Requirements for Roof Coverings
The NRCA Roofing Manual (Membrane Roof Systems; Steep-slope Roof Systems)
FM Global Property Loss Prevention Data Sheet 1-29, Roof Deck Securement and Above-Deck Roof Components
The product data sheet of the coating, adhesive or product you specify (spread rate, coverage, coats)
Plain geometry: the quantity follows from the measured length, height or area and the stated module (no outside source needed)

assume: Membrane: 10% for side and end laps and flashings.
Polyisocyanurate boards 4 x 8 ft (32 SF), 5% waste.

Insulation fasteners and plates: 8 per 4 x 8 board in the field (a starting figure: the membrane maker’s attachment pattern and the wind design, FM 1-29 / ASCE 7, set the real count; corners and perimeters take more).
Membrane fasteners in the laps: rows every 10 ft (10 ft sheets) with fasteners 12 in o.c. = 0.1 per SF (a starting figure; set by the attachment pattern).
items.note: Measure the roof area (low slope: plan area is close enough below 2:12).
